item.description: Using a free trial of the Qoder CLI, one developer spent about two days turning an idle BestV R1200-C TV box into an Alpine Linux machine running an xfce desktop. After a DLNA route failed, the agent hijacked the box's upgrade domain and forged an update package to reach recovery, then kept rebuilding images and sourcing a wifi driver until display and input worked. The author notes the tokens cost more than a proper dev board, and posted notes in the android-box-to-linux GitHub repo.

item.description: A frontend developer describes three years out of work, part of it spent on self-media, and says returning to the job market still turned up no decent opening. He switched to a few months of vibe coding, and his project now covers its costs, though he admits it trails other one-person companies by a wide margin. He still recommends self-media while noting its narrow lanes, and calls the people who appreciate you your biggest asset.

item.title: [infoq] React Native 的黄金时代，在 AI 手里结束了
item.description: Shopify is moving its mobile apps off React Native back to native Swift and Kotlin, leaning on coding agents for the rewrite; its consumer Shop app shipped a fully native version in 12 weeks. The shift came right after React Native finished a six-year architecture rewrite with Hermes V1 on by default, and engineering director Mustafa Ali said LLMs changed the core premise behind its 2020 decision.

item.description: At Huawei's HC conference, openJiuwen ScienceDiscovery presented two cases, nanobody design and civil aircraft aerodynamic design, that put literature reading, hypothesis generation, coding and experiment iteration into one environment. Its review and traceability design links outputs to execution records and cited evidence to counter fragmented tooling and research hallucination, aiming to move AI from giving answers to doing verifiable research.

item.description: QCon Shanghai 2026 runs October 22–24, covering AI Native architecture, Agent Runtime, AI Infra, and agent security and observability. Liu Zhongbing, who leads architecture governance and AI architecture evolution at Kuaishou, will present the company's approach in the AI Native architecture track, including agent silos, runaway token costs and ungoverned AI-generated code.

item.title: [infoq] .NET 11 RC1 来了：C# 15 转正，联合类型却引发争议
item.description: Microsoft released .NET 11 RC1 with a Go-Live license so teams can use it in production; C# 15 and F# 11 are the default language versions, with union types, collection expression parameters and closed class hierarchies moving from preview to stable. F# string interpolation now compiles to String.Concat for trimming and Native AOT, and dotnet test can run projects targeting Android, iOS and macOS.

item.title: [hackernews] I built non-autoregressive decision models with RL a year ago
item.description: A developer says he built non-autoregressive decision models with RL a year ago: one forward pass covers 100+ languages at roughly 33ms on GPU, built with RLCD and proper scoring rules by Convai Innovations. The point is skipping token-by-token decoding and folding multilingual inference into a single pass, which matters to anyone dealing with latency-sensitive models.

item.title: [infoq] Atlassian 通过关联指标、日志与追踪链路实现根因分析自动化
item.description: Atlassian has published a root-cause-analysis system at the CNCF that narrows scope with an OpenTelemetry service map, runs separate anomaly detectors over metrics, traces and logs, aligns them on a shared timeline, then walks upstream through the dependency graph to rank hypotheses about origin and propagation. It targets the slowest part of incident response, where engineers stitch telemetry together across fragmented dashboards, and keeps each detector independently evolvable.
